units: metres (glTF); Unreal imports at 1 uu = 1 cm, so the actor is life size

frame.handedness: preserved (det +1) -- do NOT add a mirror in Unreal
frame.note: X_gltf = -X_ras, Y_gltf = Z_ras, Z_gltf = Y_ras: anterior faces the camera, superior is up, patient right is on the viewer's left

four_chamber_plane.note: the plane the printed halves are cut on; use it as the default position of the interactive clip plane
